attributes.board_name: North Dakota Marriage and Family Therapy Licensure Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved courses (sponsor- or individually approved); all AAMFT-approved CE deemed approved; other states' board-approved CE needs ND approval; structured programs, graduate courses, home study with graded test (1 hour = 50 minutes)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Required hours are prorated for persons initially licensed during a reporting period.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal in each odd-numbered year and submit documentation on the Board form; keep certificates 5 years; random audits.

topics.who: Board-approved or AAMFT-approved supervisors (10%, within the 30 hours)

rules.notes: Home study max 15 hours (one-half). Renewal postmarked by Dec 31; $40 renewal application fee also listed; $100 late fee. Associates (LAMFT): 15 hours/year incl. 3 ethics, annual renewal $75.
rules.rule_quote: Licensed marriage and family therapists must complete a minimum of thirty hours of continuing education every two years, of which six hours must be ethics.
